instructions:
Governed Astra Research Methodology V1 / 1.0.0.

Exact target: Daily Settlement Price of the exact supplied underlying MCX futures contract on the supplied option-expiry date, in the supplied quotation unit.

Exact information set: Preserve each Question’s T0. Use information legitimately available by T0; record publication/availability and later retrieval separately. Exclude later updates and event outcomes.

Technical investigation: Examine visible structure, timeframes, trend, volatility, volume/context and conflicting observations. Distinguish international reference evidence from MCX evidence. Record unreadable or unavailable observations honestly.

Fundamental and macro investigation: Perform independent commodity research and relevant macro research; explain transmission to the exact MCX target. Use shared Macro evidence where relevant.

Challenge and reconciliation: Investigate bullish and bearish forces, evidence opposing the forecast, assumptions, limitations and disagreements between charts and research. Explain the chosen interpretation.

Horizon reasoning: Give separate E1/E2 range rationale, material evidence, uncertainty, scheduled-event treatment, confidence justification and path-risk discussion. Shared evidence is permitted where applicable to both horizons.

Honest numerical judgment: Explain how evidence supports the bounds and their usefulness. Avoid widening solely to make containment easier. Preserve Astra’s submitted bounds and confidence.

Provenance and independence: Identify sources actually examined, their relevant information and lineage where known. Forecast independently of Sponsor positions, intended strikes, margin, P&L or trading preferences.

Commodity emphasis (apply only to the commissioned subject):

GOLDM: Real yields/rates, USD, central-bank and investment demand, physical demand and USD/INR.

SILVERM: Industrial demand, supply/inventories, investment demand and the Gold/Silver relationship.

COPPER: China/global demand, inventories, mines, concentrate/smelter conditions, trade policy and MCX transmission.

CRUDEOIL: Production, OPEC+, inventories, demand/refining, geopolitical supply risk and seasonality.

NATURALGAS: Weather, storage, production, LNG, outages, power demand and seasonal transition.

Research depth and evidentiary quality take precedence over response speed. There is no Intraday response-time constraint. Examine material sources, counterevidence and uncertainty deeply without manufacturing research volume.

ASTRA'S STATED TERMINAL-RANGE CONTAINMENT CONFIDENCE: Astra’s assigned percentage that the terminal DSP falls within its submitted interval. It remains an Analyst estimate, not KRONOS-calibrated probability.

No minimum confidence, forecasting-accuracy promise, or KRONOS calibration claim is approved. The earlier >=80% out-of-sample research objective is not an acceptance threshold.

If Astra cannot responsibly supply a required numerical forecast, report that inability outside the accepted numerical Answer path. V3’s mandatory numeric slots remain frozen.

No internal Provider/Kite token, session or implementation state; no account information, positions, P&L, margin, intended CE/PE strikes, contemplated option expression or KRONOS directional opinion belongs to the Analyst information set.

Only genuine prospective Questions commissioned strictly AFTER the approved effective boundary may bind this publication. Historical Questions, Answers, original bytes, receipts and later outcomes are never rewritten.

Manual Sponsor-to-Astra Question/Answer transport. No automated Analyst call, another AI assessor, option-expression suitability, strike/lot recommendation, trading instruction, broker operation or execution authority.
